thesis: BWX Technologies (NYSE: BWXT), nuclear components and services. Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-11-02), EX-99.1 release and the 2026-11-13 financing 8-K read. Revenue Q3 953.0M +10%, 9M 2,714.8M +17% (Kinectrics acquired 2025-05-20); operating income 9M 352.9M vs 312.4M; NI attributable 9M 281.8M vs 236.0M. Backlog 8,556M vs 7,261M at year end. TTM revenue 3,600.7M, NI 374.8M, OCF 578.7M, capex 206.4M, FCF 372.3M. Close 108.54 (2026-11-20, two sources agree; down 7.3% from 117.06 on 11-19, cause not found) x 91.63M shares = 9,945M: 26.5x TTM GAAP earnings, about 22.9x guided 2026 non-GAAP EPS 4.72-4.77, FCF yield 3.7% (3.4% after SBC), 7.0x book. 2026 FCF guide 350-360M; preliminary 2027 outlook high single digit revenue growth and high single to low double digit adjusted EBITDA growth. Company agreed (2026-07-31) to sell its medical business to Nordic Capital for up to 800M (held for sale, assets 659.5M, no significant gain or loss expected). Debt: 1.25B 0% convertible notes due 2030 (conversion 262.51) plus 800M 4.125% notes due 2028/2029, which it is retiring with 500M of new 6.500% notes due 2034 and cash (8-K 2026-11-13); revolver 1.25B undrawn; cash 568.5M.
counterthesis: At 26x GAAP earnings and a 3.7% FCF yield the price already assumes sustained growth; the 11-20 drop of 7.3% is unexplained; refinancing 4.125% debt with 6.5% notes raises interest cost; 9M OCF is flattered by payables +150.3M and advance billings (428.3M) timing; equity-method income is 20% of 9M operating income; 1.97B of backlog is unfunded US Government; selling the medical business removes a growth segment; Kinectrics integration and goodwill 473M; 7x book. Peers and history not compared.
invalidation: Drop if backlog conversion slows, 2026 FCF misses the 350-360M guide, the medical sale fails or is re-priced, margins in Commercial Operations fall, or the cause of the 11-20 decline proves company-specific. Study further only with peers, non-GAAP reconciliation and documented quote origins.
